methods: Two hundred date-grouped 75:25 train-test splits; same-day cells kept together; fold-fitted feature-minimum shift, column-sum normalization to 10,000, log1p, z-scoring and PCA (3 components); 100 experimental-day-block label permutations evaluated on five fixed grouped splits; 200 date-resampled unsupervised fits; 50 grouped splits for importance and ablation. Batch2-Batch8 retained only as sequencing-submission batch metadata.
